== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rogue Insertion]] (original text; GEMP <code>2272_23</code>) with the art of •Warrior's Courage, the Decipher card the slip is printed on. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Rogue_Insertion.png]]) prints this text with an empty art box; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-rogueinsertion-pre.gif]]) prints PC-E1 ([[Rogue Insertion (Errata)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet, official text as of 15 December 2010 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]); line breaks of the game text match the slip.
* '''Original text:''' “Deploy on table. Canceled if your Senate or [Reflections 2] objective on table. Rogue Squadron pilots are spies, and, unless your character of ability > 4 at a site, power +2, armor = 4, immune to attrition < 4, and weapon destiny draws targeting them are -1 (may not be further reduced). [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1272_23</code>: Decipher art of Warrior's Courage, title, lore, Virtual Block 7 set mark, caption •Warrior's Courage (V)), without the errata mark E (the slip has none). Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
